name: claude-agents-library
description: Curated Claude Code subagents and skills

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.description: Reviews diffs for bugs, regressions, style issues, and missing tests. Read-only.

agents.name: codebase-explorer
agents.description: Answers where/how questions by searching multiple files without bloating the main context.

agents.name: fullstack-developer
agents.description: Builds complete features spanning database, API, and frontend as a cohesive unit.

agents.name: js-ts-specialist
agents.description: JavaScript/TypeScript expert across all frameworks — detects stack from package.json.

agents.name: python-specialist
agents.description: Python expert — detects framework from pyproject.toml. Covers typing, async, and performance.

agents.name: security-auditor
agents.description: Scans diffs for OWASP Top 10 issues and leaked credentials before commits or deploys.

agents.name: solidity-specialist
agents.description: Writes, reviews, audits, and tests Solidity contracts and EVM dApps end-to-end.

agents.name: system-design-expert
agents.description: Designs and reviews scalable backend systems with tradeoff reasoning across databases, scaling, APIs, and security.

agents.name: web3-specialist
agents.description: Smart contracts, EVM tooling (Foundry/Hardhat), and web3 client libraries (ethers/viem/wagmi).

skills.name: explain
skills.description: Explains what a file or function does, why it exists, and how it connects to surrounding code.

skills.name: standup
skills.description: Generates a standup update from recent git activity.

skills.name: todo
skills.description: Lists and prioritizes TODO/FIXME/HACK comments across the codebase.

skills.name: system-design
skills.description: Designs scalable systems end-to-end with tradeoff reasoning and reference material.

skills.name: solidity-dapp
skills.description: Writes, reviews, and secures Solidity contracts and web3 frontends with reference material.
